name: evidence-v4
goal: Each story gives concrete, observable evidence for at least one world condition
problem: Evidence atoms for work, care and society: is each one clear to Clef and learnable on CPU
note: Two paraphrases (a, b) and one reversed question per atom. Written before any answers were seen.

probes.a: Does {file} report the gap between rich and poor widening?
probes.b: Does {file} describe the wealthy gaining while poorer people fall behind?
probes.reversed: Does {file} report the gap between rich and poor narrowing?

probes.a: Does {file} report people suffering more anxiety, depression or stress?
probes.b: Does {file} describe mental health problems, burnout or suicide rising?
probes.reversed: Does {file} report mental health improving or distress easing?

probes.a: Does {file} report hospitals, clinics or care services under strain or short of staff or medicine?
probes.b: Does {file} describe long waits, overcrowded wards, staff shortages or drug shortages?
probes.reversed: Does {file} report waiting lists falling or care services being expanded?

probes.a: Does {file} report job cuts, layoffs or rising unemployment?
probes.b: Does {file} describe workers losing their jobs or facing redundancy?
probes.reversed: Does {file} report jobs being created or unemployment falling?

probes.a: Does {file} report wages or pay rising?
probes.b: Does {file} describe workers winning a pay rise or minimum wage increase?
probes.reversed: Does {file} report wages being cut or frozen?

probes.a: Does {file} report neighbours or local groups coming together to help each other?
probes.b: Does {file} describe volunteers, donations or a community rallying to support people?
probes.reversed: Does {file} report a local community breaking apart or neighbours turning on each other?

probes.a: Does {file} report schools, courts, permits or benefits being delivered badly?
probes.b: Does {file} describe public services failing, backlogs or people let down by a government service?
probes.reversed: Does {file} report a public service improving?

probes.a: Does {file} report free speech, voting, assembly or fair trials being restricted?
probes.b: Does {file} describe arrests of journalists or protesters, bans, censorship or unfair trials?
probes.reversed: Does {file} report rights being restored or restrictions lifted?

probes.a: Does {file} report more migrants or refugees arriving in a place?
probes.b: Does {file} describe people crossing borders, seeking asylum or fleeing to another country?
probes.reversed: Does {file} report fewer migrants arriving or people returning home?

decisions: Where does the story in {file} mainly take place or matter?
